text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day before the tryouts, I go to meet
up with Mejiro Bright and
Mejiro Dober
before heading to the Mejiro meet and
greet.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Ugh.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's past our meeting time, but Mejiro
Bright is nowhere to be seen.
After thirty
minutes of awkward silence together with
Mejiro Dober...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My, are you two alone together? Just like
peas in a pod.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
No, we're not! And Bright, you're late...
Wait, isn't that doll... Maki?
Why did you
bring her here?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I brought Maki with me.
I thought this
a good opportunity to let
her witness
Ryan's majestic aura.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Fine. Dressing her up must've delayed you, right? Everyone else has already gone ahead to the venue, so let's catch the next train.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Okay... Achoo. Mm...
It feels as if it could
snow at any moment.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just like Mejiro Bright predicted, snow
begins falling on our way
there. It's as if
we've gone back to the middle of winter,
with mounds of snow everywhere you look.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! McQueen and Ryan haven't arrived
yet?

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, traffic jams caused by the
sudden snowfall have rendered their
vehicle inoperable. Running would be
dangerous, so they're currently looking to
catch the next train over.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
But they won't make it in time, will they?
There's only five minutes
until the event is
supposed to start, and the venue is
already filled with fans...

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text:
We'll explain the situation to the fans
and have them wait a little
longer. I'm sure
they will understand, though they may
become a little restless.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I understand the situation. In that case... how about we talk to the fans instead? ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? Wait, what?! You want the two of
us to stall until they arrive?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Though we lack experience, we still
bear the Mejiro name. Rather than making
the fans wait, we can entertain them and
make
this event a success.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Well,
I can see where you're coming from...
but I don't know. I mean...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what they'll talk about today.
It's
not every day that you see
so many
Mejiros in one place!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Right? In just a few more minutes,
we'll get to see their majestic and
beautiful faces in the flesh... Oh wow,
I'll make sure to burn this sight
into my eyes forever!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...I can't do it!
Talking in front of that many
people... it's too much for
me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Dober,
I know I'm asking a lot from you.
However, I am certain that by myself, I
won't be able to talk to the fans very
well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
That is why I need your assistance. We'll
just be talking—like we are
now... okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Talking isn't the problem... We have to do
it in front of all these fans,
right? ...Sorry. I
don't have the confidence...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
It'll be fine,
don't worry. I shall be with you
every step of the way.
You can trust me...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though Mejiro Bright is doing her best to
encourage Mejiro Dober, I
can't help but
notice that her hand is trembling as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
If it were McQueen, Ryan, or any other
Mejiro, I'm sure they would
boldly step
forward and resolve the situation. This
time, it's our turn...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I've decided—
I will become the light of the
Mejiro family!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She made up her mind to live up to the
Mejiro name—pursuing
perfection in any
and all situations. As for me...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
With that said,
I do not wish to force your
hand. It's okay. I shall take
the stage
alone—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Greetings, it's nice to meet everyone! ♪
My name is Mejiro Bright.
And joining me
today is...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ...Maki?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: "...Hello, I'm Maki. Nice to meet you..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Those two haven't made their debuts
yet, have they? Is this
supposed to be the
opening act?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Also... she called her Maki,
but isn't that
Dober? Are they doing a
puppet show?
You don't see that too often.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You want me to talk as the doll?! Are you
sure you're not just trying to
make things
harder for me?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The idea I came up with was to have
Mejiro Dober talk to the fans
while
holding Mejiro Bright's doll.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the doll as a third emcee, fewer
people would look at Mejiro Dober. On
top of that, by talking as the doll, she
could avoid looking the audience in the
eye.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
B-but... I just don't think I can do it.
I can't
stop thinking about how I
might tarnish the
Mejiro name...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright loves her family more than
anything else. With her here, the Mejiro
family's reputation is sure to be safe.
But more
importantly...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Provisional Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...It's as Provisional Trainer says.
I'll cover
you, so don't worry. I'll
make sure you
don't burst into tears on stage.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Who said I'd burst into tears?! ...Fine,
I get
it. I want to help out too...
so I'll give it my
best shot!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
And that's when Ryan took me by the
hand to run together with her.
She was so
cool in that moment.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Mm... Ryan's cool, all right. She's always
been looking out for us. And
she doesn't
let it go to her head.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Every Mejiro has been spectacular
even from a young age.
We're aiming to
become like that too someday. Right,
Berry?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yeah—"I mean, what're you saying?! I'm
Maki! How many times do I
gotta tell
you?!"

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, they're so adorable. ♪
I get it, this
is a bit they're doing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Both Dober and Bright have done well. We
are in their debt.
However... why the doll?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting! We'll take it
from here!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
McQueen and Ryan take the stage and the
crowd goes wild. It looks
like Bright and
Dober have saved the day.
